test_adversarial_robustness: test a neural network model against adversarial attacks using Gaussian, Uniform, or custom data perturbations
run_test_with_gaussian_noise: run the test function with Gaussian noise perturbations on a CIFAR-10 or CIFAR-100 trained model
run_test_with_uniform_noise: run the test function with Uniform noise perturbations on a CIFAR-10 or CIFAR-100 trained model
run_test_with_custom_dataset: run the test function with a custom ImageFolder dataset for outlier detection evaluation
review_test_function: review the test function that loads models, sets up data loaders, and delegates to calData and calMetric modules
